summary: Ridgetech, Inc. filed a Form 6-K confirming completion of a par value capital reduction and share subdivision approved at its August 25, 2026 annual general meeting. Par value per ordinary share was cut from US$0.15 to US$0.0001 via cancellation of paid-up capital supported by an August 1, 2026 solvency statement, then each authorized unissued ordinary share was subdivided into 1,500 new shares. The Cayman Registrar registered the filings and issued the Certificate of Share Capital Reduction effective September 2, 2026. Authorized capital is now US$36,010,000 across 360 billion ordinary shares and 10 million preferred shares. What to watch: any subsequent reverse split or Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance mechanics.
